preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t have length at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c == '?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists only of lowercase Latin letters and question marks.
String t consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The product of the lengths of s and t does not exceed 10^7.

postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer string.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - len(t) + 1) if all((s[i+j] == '?' or s[i+j] == t[j]) for j in range(len(t))) for _ in [0]), 0)
postconditions.description: The output integer equals the maximum possible number of occurrences of t in s, where each occurrence at index i is valid if for all j, s[i+j] is either '?' or matches t[j], and the maximum is taken over all possible replacements of '?' in s.
